system.description: Spend two Blood Traits and establish eye contact or touch (a Physical Challenge may be needed), declaring in advance whether you intend to frighten, render unconscious, or kill the target. Frightening requires one won Mental Challenge and inflicts two turns of agony plus lasting Willpower and Trait penalties; knocking unconscious requires winning two Mental Challenges and inflicts lasting harm and unconsciousness; killing requires winning three Mental Challenges outright. Losing all attempted challenges when trying to kill or incapacitate renders the target immune to Psychic Assault from you for the rest of the night.
system.bloodCost: Two Blood Traits (plus one Willpower Trait vs. supernaturals)
system.duration: Two turns to instant, per declared effect
